## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; confirmation: broad sector positivity (8/11) and a MAJOR divergence across Big Tech where multiple large-cap names show 1W up / 1M down (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, META) indicating mixed internals; Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Top performers from Technology).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare leads: JNJ (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +13.20%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +7.65% | 1M: +14.07%) ABOVE TREND. Technology is also strong on the week but mixed vs month: PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND and ADBE (1W: +13.60% | 1M: -16.17%) RECOVERY.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Real Estate, Energy and Utilities lag: DLR (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -6.84%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -0.33% | 1M: -8.34%) BELOW TREND, VST (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -4.25%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PLTR (1W: +20.54% | 1M: -15.03%) RECOVERY, NOW (1W: +18.77% | 1M: -16.71%) RECOVERY, PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +13.60% | 1M: -16.17%) RECOVERY, APD (1W: +12.94% | 1M: +13.19%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Tech), style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: T (1W: -8.21% | 1M: -16.48%) BELOW TREND, CAT (1W: -8.84% | 1M: +5.90%) CORRECTION, INTC (1W: -9.42% | 1M: +11.51%) CORRECTION, AMAT (1W: -9.72% | 1M: +23.06%) CORRECTION, DLR (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -6.84%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select Tech and Real Estate names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: PLTR (1W: +20.54% | 1M: -15.03%) RECOVERY, NOW (1W: +18.77% | 1M: -16.71%) RECOVERY, PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND; note MAJOR divergence as several mega-caps (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL) are RECOVERY vs longer-term weakness — tactical, not clear structural breakout.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech shows a short-term bounce with mixed monthly internals: AAPL (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: +10.67% | 1M: -11.52%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: -0.46% | 1M: -12.46%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: +4.71% | 1M: -0.48%) RECOVERY. Sector breadth positive on the week but internals are conflicted.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are constructive: MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +9.56% | 1M: +14.12%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +11.13%) CORRECTION; sector 1W positive and showing relative strength but leadership is not solely in Financials.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is a clear leader on both timeframes: JNJ (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +13.20%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +7.65% | 1M: +14.07%) ABOVE TREND — sector breadth on the week is favorable.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Healthcare and high-quality Financials (e.g., JNJ (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to weak Real Estate/Energy/Utilities (DLR (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -6.84%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -0.33% | 1M: -8.34%) BELOW TREND, VST (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -4.25%) BELOW TREND). Monitor Big Tech recoveries (AAPL (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: +10.67% | 1M: -11.52%) RECOVERY) given the major divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: QCOM (1W: -13.98% | 1M: -26.55%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -12.55% | 1M: +5.16%) CORRECTION, DLR (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -6.84%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (breadth supportive; JNJ/UNH/LLY ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Utilities/Real Estate (VST/DLR BELOW TREND) and pockets of Energy (XOM BELOW TREND).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
PANW above recent breakout implied continuation if it holds near weekly gains (PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND). AAPL support to watch on this short-term bounce: AAPL (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%) RECOVERY. QCOM failure to reclaim near-term levels would confirm distribution: QCOM (1W: -13.98% | 1M: -26.55%) BELOW TREND.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
QCOM (+60): QCOM (1W: -13.98% | 1M: -26.55%) BELOW TREND — positive supply-agreement headline but price is falling, a divergence that looks like distribution. ASML (+50) noted in news but not in the provided return set for confirmation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
LRCX (-50): LRCX (1W: -12.55% | 1M: +5.16%) CORRECTION — negative headlines align with near-term selling; watch for trend break. AAPL (-45): AAPL (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%) RECOVERY — bearish headlines are diverging from the short-term bounce, monitor for follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Tech concentration at the top and broad 8/11 sector positivity. Healthcare and select Financials are showing strength (JNJ ABOVE TREND, MA ABOVE TREND, PANW ABOVE TREND). Key risk: major divergence in Big Tech (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL RECOVERY vs monthly weakness) and several sentiment-driven names (QCOM) showing bullish headlines but below-trend prices — monitor for confirmation.
